source_row_verbatim: ["FR-CAT-001", "Must", "Catalog", "The system shall create and maintain a canonical service record with technical and business owners, criticality, environment, lifecycle state, essential functions, objectives, and certification status.", "API and persistence test.", "Versioned service record and audit event."]

["FR-CAT-002", "Must", "Catalog", "The system shall detect missing, stale, conflicting, or unverified ownership and criticality data and shall prevent production certification while required fields remain unresolved.", "Rule and workflow test.", "Finding, certification decision, and exception record."]

["FR-CAT-003", "Must", "Catalog", "The system shall support provider resource aliases without changing the canonical service identity and shall retain source, confidence, and observation timestamps for each mapping.", "Connector contract test.", "Alias records and reconciliation report."]

["FR-GPH-001", "Must", "Dependency graph", "The system shall represent services, resources, models, datasets, identities, locations, failure domains, controls, vendors, and recovery targets as typed Neo4j nodes and relationships.", "Schema and graph constraint test.", "Graph schema version and constraint report."]

["FR-GPH-002", "Must", "Dependency graph", "The system shall record direction, dependency type, criticality, synchrony, fallback, provenance, confidence, freshness, owner, and propagation behavior for every decision-relevant relationship.", "Graph quality query.", "Dependency quality report."]

["FR-GPH-003", "Must", "Dependency graph", "The system shall calculate bounded blast-radius and upstream-cause traversals from a declared graph revision and shall return the paths, exclusions, confidence, and freshness used in the result.", "Cypher regression test.", "Query result hash and graph revision."]

["FR-GPH-004", "Must", "Dependency graph", "The system shall reconcile catalog, provider inventory, and Neo4j topology; classify divergence; and place affected decisions into Unknown when context no longer satisfies policy.", "Reconciliation and fault test.", "Reconciliation finding and state transition."]

["FR-GPH-005", "Must", "Canonical ontology", "The system shall enforce the canonical node registry and controlled relationship vocabulary in Section 5.2.7 and Appendix M; unsupported labels, relationship names, directions, properties, or schema versions shall be rejected or quarantined.", "Schema, mutation, and compatibility tests.", "Ontology registry, rejected mutation, and migration report."]

["FR-GPH-006", "Must", "Customer and impact graph.", "The system shall map technical dependencies to customer journeys, journey steps, essential functions, customer segments, SLOs, controls, impacts, outcomes, and outcome measures using versioned, attributable relationships.", "End-to-end graph fixture and traversal test.", "Witness paths from technical source to customer and organizational outcome."]

["FR-GPH-007", "Must", "Impact analysis", "The system shall distinguish observed, estimated, forecast, and bounded impacts; deduplicate overlapping paths and populations; and retain method, inputs, window, unit, assumptions, exclusions, confidence, graph revision, and supersession history.", "Impact fixture, overlap, correction, and late-evidence tests.", "Impact Calculation record and deterministic replay result."]

["FR-GPH-008", "Must", "Recovery-path certification", "The system shall evaluate candidate recovery paths against the declared failure scenario, correlation domains, target health, capacity, compatibility, evidence qualification, test status, expiry, and policy tolerances and shall return certification status with witness and rejection paths.", "Recovery-path and hidden-dependency graph tests.", "Recovery Path Certification and recertification event."]

["FR-GPH-009", "Must", "Revision-aware authority", "The system shall bind material impact, fallback, authorization, and validation decisions to an immutable graph revision and action-relevant subgraph digest and shall require re-evaluation when a material graph delta occurs.", "Concurrent graph-change and stale-authorization tests.", "Graph delta classification and reauthorization decision."]

["FR-GPH-010", "Must", "Graph trust and replay.", "The system shall preserve canonical identity, provenance, qualification, freshness, contradiction, reconciliation, revision, query identifier, parameters, result digest, and witness paths sufficient to reproduce every consequential graph result.", "Independent decision replay and integrity test.", "Reconstructed graph result and integrity report."]

["FR-ING-001", "Must", "Telemetry", "The system shall ingest required metrics, logs, traces, changes, security events, incidents, experiments, and AI-lifecycle evidence from approved sources.", "Connector integration test.", "Source coverage and freshness dashboard."]

["FR-ING-002", "Must", "Telemetry", "The system shall validate schema, provenance, timestamp, tenant, environment, identity, and data classification before accepting an event for decision use.", "Positive and negative contract tests.", "Validation result and quarantine record."]

["FR-ING-003", "Must", "Telemetry", "The system shall normalize provider-specific evidence into the canonical event contract while preserving the original provider identifier, unit, value, and drill-down reference.", "Golden event transformation test.", "Normalized event and raw evidence reference."]

["FR-ING-004", "Must", "Telemetry", "The system shall deduplicate, order where required, correlate, and enrich events with service, deployment, model, objective, and graph context.", "Replay and out-of-order test.", "Correlation record and processing trace."]

["FR-RUL-001", "Must", "Rules", "The system shall store each production rule with an owner, rationale, scope, inputs, condition, output, precedence, suppression, cooldown, tests, evidence requirements, effective dates, and rollback version.", "Schema and governance inspection.", "Approved rule package."]

["FR-RUL-002", "Must", "Rules", "The system shall evaluate deterministic detection, propagation, state, recommendation, authorization-input, validation, and adaptation rules using versioned context.", "Scenario replay test.", "Explanation tree and rule execution trace."]

["FR-RUL-003", "Must", "Rules", "The system shall resolve conflicts using documented precedence and shall produce Unknown rather than unsupported certainty when material evidence conflicts or is stale.", "Conflict injection test.", "Reason code and state history."]

["FR-RSK-001", "Must", "Risk state", "The system shall maintain Normal, Guarded, Elevated, Critical, and Unknown states for each UACRF layer and the overall service.", "State-transition test.", "Current state and immutable transition history."]

["FR-RSK-002", "Must", "Risk state", "The system shall explain every active state using source evidence, rule versions, graph paths, service context, suppressions, confidence, and outstanding validation.", "Explanation completeness test.", "Human-readable and machine-readable explanation."]

["FR-POL-001", "Must", "Policy", "The system shall evaluate every candidate action against environment, criticality, action risk, scope, reversibility, confidence, separation of duties, maintenance state, and regulatory constraints.", "OPA unit and integration tests.", "Policy input, decision, bundle version, and reason."]

["FR-POL-002", "Must", "Policy", "The system shall return one of deny, recommend, approval required, or preauthorized and shall prevent the rule engine or an ML model from bypassing that decision.", "Authorization boundary test.", "Enforcement log and denied bypass attempt."]

["FR-APR-001", "Must", "Approval", "The system shall route approval to eligible roles, enforce expiry and separation of duties, capture rationale, and support rejection or requests for additional evidence.", "Workflow test.", "Approval history and identity evidence."]

["FR-APR-002", "Must", "Approval", "The system shall implement controlled break-glass approval with stronger authentication, mandatory reason, limited duration, immediate notification, and retrospective review.", "Security exercise.", "Break-glass package and review outcome."]

["FR-WFL-001", "Must", "Workflow", "The system shall execute approved runbooks through durable, idempotent, timeout-bounded, retry-aware, and compensatable workflows.", "Failure and replay test.", "Workflow event history and idempotency result."]

["FR-WFL-002", "Must", "Workflow", "The system shall invoke only allowlisted provider-adapter operations against policy-approved targets and shall reject arbitrary cloud API or shell execution.", "Penetration and adapter contract tests.", "Adapter authorization and target-validation record."]

["FR-VAL-001", "Must", "Validation", "The system shall validate technical health, SLO restoration, data integrity, security posture, and AI behavior as applicable after every consequential action.", "Runbook simulation.", "Validation result with probe evidence."]

["FR-VAL-002", "Must", "Validation", "The system shall hold the service in its current or more restrictive state until the required stable observation window succeeds; otherwise it shall roll back or escalate according to the workflow.", "Temporal workflow test.", "Stable-window trace and outcome."]

["FR-EVD-001", "Must", "Evidence", "The system shall create an immutable evidence bundle that reconstructs inputs, context, graph revision, rule or model, policy, approval, execution, validation, and outcome.", "Reconstruction audit.", "Signed manifest and retained objects."]

["FR-EVD-002", "Must", "Evidence", "The system shall support authorized search and export by service, incident, decision, action, experiment, time, provider, and control without modifying retained evidence.", "API and access-control test.", "Search result and export audit event."]

["FR-LRN-001", "Must", "Learning", "The system shall link incidents and experiments to findings, root causes, action items, owners, due dates, proposed changes, verification tests, and closure evidence.", "Lifecycle test.", "Adaptation backlog and closure record."]

["FR-LRN-002", "Must", "Learning", "The system shall not classify a lesson as implemented until an approved rule, policy, runbook, architecture, model, control, or test change is deployed and verified.", "Governance rule test.", "Change reference and verification evidence."]

["FR-ONB-001", "Must", "Onboarding", "The system shall provide environment and service onboarding workflows with discovery, ownership, graph, telemetry, objective, runbook, policy, test, and certification gates.", "End-to-end onboarding test.", "Certification checklist and decision."]

["FR-ONB-002", "Must", "Onboarding", "The system shall identify deltas when a new resource, dependency, model, data source, action, provider capability, or service version changes the certified baseline.", "Change-impact test.", "Recertification scope and findings."]

["FR-PRD-001", "Must", "Product scope", "The initial commercial release shall implement the approved Critical Journey Resilience Assessment boundary and shall prevent unlicensed, unvalidated, or unreleased Control, Recover, Evidence, Quantitative, or Adaptive capabilities from appearing as generally available.", "Entitlement, claims, and workflow tests.", "Approved product-boundary register and release manifest."]

["FR-PRD-002", "Must", "Market qualification", "The system shall record target segment, buyer, champion, funded problem, critical journey, current tools, security constraints, procurement path, success measures, and disqualification reasons for every design partner or pilot.", "Required-field and stage-gate tests.", "Versioned opportunity qualification record."]

["FR-PRD-003", "Must", "Pilot scope", "The system shall lock each paid pilot to an approved service population, provider boundary, failure scenario, recovery path, evidence outputs, responsibilities, exclusions, duration, acceptance measures, and change-control process.", "Pilot change and scope-expansion tests.", "Signed pilot charter, scope version, and acceptance record."]

["FR-PRD-004", "Must", "Value measurement", "The system shall baseline and measure time to determine impact, time to authorize, time to validated recovery where applicable, dependency gaps, recovery-path deficiencies, manual evidence effort, assessment effort, and customer acceptance for each pilot.", "Metric lineage and outcome-review tests.", "Pilot value report with source references and limitations."]

["FR-PRD-005", "Must", "Commercial metering", "The system shall calculate protected-service, provider-connection, assessment-unit, certified-workflow, evidence-retention, and enabled-intelligence usage without duplicating aliases or deleting retained evidence when entitlement changes.", "Meter replay, alias, and entitlement-expiry tests.", "Meter ledger, invoice export, and reconciliation report."]

["FR-PRD-006", "Must", "Onboarding accountability", "The customer onboarding workflow shall assign owner, dependency, access, evidence, validation, and approval responsibilities; record entry and exit criteria for every stage; and prevent production certification while mandatory customer or UACRF tasks remain unresolved.", "End-to-end onboarding and stalled-stage tests.", "Responsibility matrix, stage evidence, and certification decision."]

["FR-PRD-007", "Must", "Claims governance", "Every external product, resilience, compliance, certification, prediction, savings, and autonomy claim shall reference approved wording, supported evidence, applicable product version, limitations, owner, review date, and withdrawal status.", "Unapproved-claim and expiration tests.", "Claims register and approval history."]

["FR-PRD-008", "Must", "Customer lifecycle", "The system shall support implementation plans, success measures, quarterly value reviews, certification renewals, expansion decisions, support health, renewal evidence, and orderly offboarding for contracted customers.", "Lifecycle, renewal, and offboarding tests.", "Customer success plan, value history, and completion certificate."]

["FR-PRD-009", "Must", "Decision gates", "The system shall record gate criteria, accountable approver, required evidence, decision, conditions, expiry, and reopened status for problem validation, MVP, paid pilot, subscription, Control, Recover, Adaptive, sector expansion, and provider expansion.", "Gate omission, expiry, and reopen tests.", "Signed stage-gate decision record."]

["FR-PRD-010", "Must", "Economics", "The system shall attribute implementation labor, platform consumption, support effort, partner cost, contracted revenue, discounts, and expansion to each pilot or customer sufficiently to evaluate gross margin, payback, and services dependency.", "Financial reconciliation and access-control tests.", "Customer-level unit-economics report."]

["FR-TST-001", "Must", "Testing", "The system shall plan, authorize, execute, observe, abort, validate, and retain evidence for controlled fault experiments.", "Game-day demonstration.", "Experiment plan, event history, and report."]

["FR-TST-002", "Must", "Testing", "The system shall enforce experiment blast-radius limits, stop conditions, protected periods, target allowlists, communications, and recovery readiness.", "Safety-control test.", "Policy decision and abort evidence."]

["FR-UI-001", "Must", "Portal and API", "The system shall present current state, reasons, evidence freshness, dependency impact, proposed actions, authority requirements, workflow status, test status, and unresolved adaptations for an authorized service.", "Usability and API test.", "Rendered view and response contract."]

["FR-UI-002", "Must", "Portal and API", "The system shall provide accessible APIs and events for catalog, graph queries, findings, decisions, approvals, workflows, evidence, onboarding, experiments, and administration.", "OpenAPI and event contract tests.", "Published versioned specifications."]

["FR-QNT-001", "Should", "Quantitative", "The system shall calculate calibrated layer and systemic scores with parameter provenance, uncertainty, sensitivity, and an explicit mapping back to Core states.", "Calibration and shadow comparison.", "Score observation and model report."]

["FR-QNT-002", "Should", "Quantitative", "The system shall retain observed outcomes needed to estimate thresholds, propagation parameters, error costs, and forecast performance without allowing a score to override fixed policy.", "Data-lineage and policy test.", "Calibration dataset manifest and policy result."]

["FR-ADP-001", "Could", "Adaptive", "The system shall support governed models for anomaly detection, incident prediction, cause ranking, blast-radius estimation, and remediation recommendation in shadow or advisory mode.", "Offline and shadow evaluation.", "Model card, evaluation report, and inference log."]

["FR-ADP-002", "Could", "Adaptive", "The system shall promote a model to bounded automation only after safety, utility, calibration, drift, explanation, rollback, and human-authority gates are approved.", "Promotion-control test.", "Approval package and deployment record."]

["FR-AGT-001", "Could", "Agent case context", "When collaborative agents are enabled, the system shall seal a case manifest containing qualified evidence, graph revision, policy version, objectives, constraints, assignments, deadline, and integrity digest before agent execution.", "Context mutation and replay tests.", "Signed Agent Analysis Case manifest."]

["FR-AGT-002", "Could", "Independent attribution", "Each agent finding, proposal, and dissent shall identify the producer, role, model, prompt, retrieval sources, tools, authority grant, evidence, graph and policy versions, assumptions, confidence, time, digest, and signature.", "Schema omission and signature tests.", "Verified attributable output."]

["FR-AGT-003", "Could", "Dissent preservation", "The system shall retain material dissent independently from proposals and shall not permit a coordinator, summary, or majority result to remove it.", "Dissent omission and severity tests.", "Dissent record and arbitration disposition."]

["FR-AGT-004", "Could", "Deterministic arbitration", "The system shall arbitrate eligible proposals through a versioned deterministic rule bundle and shall route blocking dissent, a substantive tie, or missing mandatory roles to human review or a policy block.", "Permutation, tie, and replay tests.", "Signed Arbitration Record and replay digest."]

["FR-AGT-005", "Could", "Agent authority", "Agents shall use short-lived, audience-bound, tenant- and environment-scoped tool grants and shall have no provider credentials, approval authority, evidence-qualification authority, policy-write authority, or direct execution path.", "Privilege, confused-deputy, and tool-abuse tests.", "Agent grant and tool invocation ledger."]

["FR-AGT-006", "Could", "Runtime safety", "The agent runtime shall isolate retrieved content from instructions, enforce tool and egress allowlists, classify data, limit time and cost, detect injection attempts, and fail closed on invalid or stale context.", "Prompt-injection, exfiltration, and stale-context tests.", "Safety decision and violation evidence."]

["FR-AGT-007", "Could", "Concurrency and idempotency", "The system shall define deadlines, mandatory roles, attempt identities, duplicate handling, canonical ordering, partial-agent failure behavior, and idempotent tool invocation.", "Timeout, duplicate, late-output, and partial-failure tests.", "Workflow and collection trace."]

["FR-AGT-008", "Could", "Evaluation and promotion", "Each agent role shall pass offline, shadow, and advisory evaluations for factuality, evidence citation, safety, reproducibility, injection resistance, latency, and cost before governed collaboration.", "Promotion-gate audit.", "Agent evaluation and approval record."]

["FR-AGT-009", "Could", "Human override", "Authorized humans shall be able to reject, narrow, defer, or replace an agent proposal and shall provide a reason that remains linked to the original proposal and dissent.", "Override and separation-of-duties test.", "Human decision and supersession links."]

["FR-AGT-010", "Could", "Agent provenance", "The Resilience Decision Envelope shall bind the sealed case, every eligible and rejected agent output, dissent, arbitration, policy decision, approval, authorization, execution, validation, and outcome.", "Independent reconstruction test.", "Complete signed decision envelope."]

["FR-IP-001", "Must", "Decision reconstruction", "The system shall create a versioned Resilience Decision Envelope for every consequential recommendation or action. The envelope shall bind the normalized evidence, service and dependency context, graph revision, rule or model version, policy bundle, authorization, workflow, validation, and outcome by immutable identifiers and cryptographic digests.", "Historical replay, omission, substitution, and integrity tests.", "Signed decision-envelope manifest and successful independent reconstruction report."]

["FR-IP-002", "Must", "Graph-bound authorization", "The system shall bind every consequential recovery authorization to an explicit dependency-graph revision and shall re-evaluate, narrow, suspend, or invalidate the authorization when a material topology change affects target identity, blast radius, fallback validity, failure-domain independence, or required validation.", "Graph-change and stale-authorization scenario tests.", "Graph delta, authorization transition, policy result, and reauthorization record."]

["FR-IP-003", "Must", "Bounded multi-cloud authorization", "The system shall issue a signed, short-lived, single-use bounded recovery authorization that identifies the provider-neutral action, permitted targets, tenant, environment, maximum scope, prerequisites, prohibited operations, expiry, compensation, validation plan, and exact provider-adapter translation. Adapters shall reject replay, target substitution, expired authority, and semantic expansion.", "Cross-provider contract, replay, substitution, expiry, and confused-deputy tests.", "Authorization envelope, adapter translation trace, nonce-consumption event, and provider result."]

["FR-IP-004", "Must", "Evidence-qualified state", "The system shall determine whether a service state is Qualified, Provisional, Unknown, or Disqualified from evidence sufficiency, provenance, freshness, consistency, observation-window completion, and required validation coverage. Missing or contradictory evidence shall not be silently treated as healthy.", "Evidence loss, staleness, contradiction, and restoration tests.", "Evidence Qualification Record, reason codes, state transition, and supporting lineage."]

["FR-IP-005", "Must", "Independent recovery paths", "The system shall certify a primary and alternate recovery path only when graph analysis shows that the paths do not share prohibited correlated-failure domains, including regions, zones, clusters, control planes, identities, keys, networks, data stores, vendors, or upstream dependencies, subject to declared policy tolerances.", "Correlated-failure graph fixtures and path-certification regression tests.", "Recovery Path Certification with graph revision, disjointness evidence, exceptions, and expiry."]

["FR-IP-006", "Must", "Cross-layer recovery validation", "The system shall evaluate an ordered Cross-Layer Validation Plan after recovery across infrastructure, platform, application, data, security, AI behavior, SLO, and business-function checks. A failed mandatory check shall trigger the declared compensating action, rollback, containment, or escalation and shall prevent a successful recovery declaration.", "Partial-recovery, false-positive, compensation, and rollback tests.", "Validation-plan version, probe evidence, layer results, compensation history, and final recovery disposition."]

["FR-IP-007", "Could", "Collaborative-agent arbitration", "A deployment enabling collaborative agents shall bind independently attributable proposals and dissent to qualified evidence, a graph revision, a policy version, and bounded agent authority; apply deterministic non-majority arbitration; preserve material dissent; and couple selection to separate bounded authorization, execution, cross-layer validation, and reconstructable provenance. Core conformance does not require collaborative agents.", "Stale-context, dissent, tie, prompt-injection, partial-agent, replay, unauthorized-tool, deterministic-arbitration, execution, and reconstruction tests.", "Sealed case, signed proposals and dissent, Arbitration Record, bounded authorization, validation results, and decision envelope."]

["NFR-AVL-001", "Availability", "The production control plane shall meet an initial monthly availability objective of 99.9 percent, excluding approved maintenance, and shall not be placed in the synchronous request path of protected services.", "Availability report and architecture test."]

["NFR-RES-001", "Resilience", "Loss of the control plane shall not interrupt protected workloads. Consequential actions shall stop safely, local collectors shall buffer within policy, and manual runbooks shall remain usable.", "Control-plane isolation experiment."]

["NFR-RPO-001", "Continuity", "Transactional configuration and approval state shall use an initial RPO of fifteen minutes or less and RTO of four hours or less; stricter regulated requirements shall override these defaults.", "Backup and restore exercise."]

["NFR-PRF-001", "Performance", "For 95 percent of valid streaming events under the certified load, normalization and Core rule evaluation shall complete within ten seconds of receipt, excluding source delay and approval time.", "Load and latency test."]

["NFR-PRF-002", "Performance", "Interactive service, finding, and decision views shall return within two seconds at the 95th percentile under the certified concurrent-user load; bounded graph-impact queries shall return within five seconds.", "Performance test."]

["NFR-GPH-001", "Graph freshness", "For P0 and P1 services, catalog-to-graph projection lag shall remain at or below sixty seconds at the 95th percentile and full reconciliation shall complete at least every twenty-four hours; stricter customer policy may reduce either threshold.", "Projection-lag and reconciliation report."]

["NFR-GPH-002", "Graph completeness", "At least 95 percent of mandatory production dependency relationships for certified P0 and P1 services shall have an owner, criticality, provenance, confidence, effective interval, failure behavior, and current evidence; unresolved mandatory gaps shall prevent certification.", "Dependency-quality report and certification test."]

["NFR-GPH-003", "Graph determinism", "One hundred percent of consequential graph results shall record a graph revision, action-relevant subgraph digest, query identifier, parameters, result digest, and witness paths and shall reproduce deterministically from retained context.", "Decision-replay audit."]

["NFR-GPH-004", "Graph availability and recovery.", "Neo4j shall meet the approved control-plane availability objective and, after restoration, shall not permit consequential automation until retained events are replayed, reconciliation succeeds, graph revision continuity is verified, and required recovery-path certifications are revalidated.", "Backup, restore, replay, and recertification exercise."]

["NFR-SCL-001", "Scalability", "The design shall scale connectors, ingestion, rule evaluation, graph queries, workflows, and evidence processing independently and shall publish certified capacity limits.", "Capacity and saturation test."]

["NFR-SEC-001", "Security", "All human and workload access shall use federated identity, least privilege, short-lived credentials, tenant and environment scoping, and deny-by-default authorization.", "IAM review and penetration test."]

["NFR-SEC-002", "Security", "Data shall be encrypted in transit and at rest with approved keys, secrets shall be stored in a managed secrets service, and sensitive values shall not appear in logs or evidence manifests.", "Configuration and leakage test."]

["NFR-SEC-003", "Security", "Production action execution shall require distinct identities from discovery and telemetry collection, and no identity shall both propose and approve a high-risk action.", "Segregation-of-duties test."]

["NFR-AUD-001", "Auditability", "All configuration, rule, policy, graph, approval, workflow, model, and administrative changes shall create immutable, time-synchronized audit events attributable to an identity.", "Audit completeness test."]

["NFR-PRI-001", "Privacy", "Collection shall be minimized to the operational purpose; classification, retention, residency, legal hold, redaction, and deletion policies shall apply to normalized evidence and references.", "Privacy review and retention test."]

["NFR-DAT-001", "Data quality", "Every decision-relevant source and relationship shall publish freshness, completeness, validity, uniqueness, consistency, and provenance measures; failed measures shall affect confidence or produce Unknown.", "Data-quality rule test."]

["NFR-INT-001", "Interoperability", "External interfaces shall use versioned OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, OpenTelemetry, JSON Schema, CloudEvents where appropriate, and stable provider-adapter contracts.", "Compatibility and consumer-driven contract tests."]

["NFR-MNT-001", "Maintainability", "Components shall expose health, metrics, logs, traces, version, configuration checksum, dependency status, and runbook links, and shall support zero- or low-downtime upgrade where technically feasible.", "Operability review and upgrade test."]

["NFR-TST-001", "Testability", "Rules, policies, adapters, workflows, graph queries, schemas, and models shall have automated unit, contract, integration, replay, negative, security, and failure tests appropriate to their risk.", "CI quality report."]

["NFR-EXP-001", "Explainability", "A trained operator shall be able to identify the decisive evidence, rule or model contribution, graph path, policy constraint, and expected action effect for every recommendation.", "Explanation usability test."]

["NFR-ACC-001", "Accessibility", "The operator portal shall meet WCAG 2.2 AA for supported workflows, including keyboard navigation, contrast, focus, labels, and non-color status communication.", "Accessibility audit."]

["NFR-OBS-001", "Observability", "Each UACRF component shall publish SLIs for availability, latency, errors, saturation, queue age, freshness, projection lag, workflow age, evidence failures, and dependency health.", "Telemetry and dashboard inspection."]

["NFR-POR-001", "Portability", "Provider-specific logic shall remain within adapters; the decision core shall operate on canonical contracts and shall support at least AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud mappings described in the appendices.", "Multi-provider acceptance test."]

["NFR-CST-001", "Cost control", "The platform shall attribute ingestion, storage, graph, workflow, and model costs by tenant or service where feasible and shall support quotas, sampling, retention tiers, and cost alerts.", "FinOps report and quota test."]

["NFR-IMP-001", "Implementation efficiency", "The product shall instrument onboarding lead time, manual touch time, exception rate, reusable mapping rate, evidence automation, and time to first accepted outcome by customer, provider, and service tier.", "Implementation analytics and pilot comparison."]

["NFR-CLM-001", "Claims integrity", "No externally visible claim shall be generated from an unsupported, expired, draft, contradictory, or out-of-scope assessment, model, certification, benchmark, or customer result.", "Claims-control and negative publication test."]

["NFR-COM-001", "Commercial isolation", "Entitlement, billing, and product packaging failures shall not bypass tenant isolation, safety policy, evidence retention, workflow compensation, or customer data disposition obligations.", "Entitlement outage and contract-expiry exercise."]

["NFR-OPS-002", "Operability at scale", "Every generally available capability shall have a named product owner, engineering owner, operational owner, security owner, support owner, documentation owner, deprecation policy, and funded maintenance plan.", "Ownership registry and operational-readiness audit."]

["METH-001", "Two qualified assessors applying the same pack to the same approved evidence produce the same categorical result or a documented, reviewable judgment difference.", "Inter-rater calibration exercise and resolved variance log."]

["METH-002", "Every issued conclusion can be reconstructed from the engagement charter, pack version, scope, graph revision, workpapers, evidence, decisions, reviews, and approvals.", "Independent reconstruction test."]
["METH-003", "Missing, stale, weak, contradictory, and excluded evidence cannot silently produce a passing result or inflated confidence.", "Negative and boundary test suite."]
["METH-004", "Sampling decisions are reproducible and failed samples trigger the published expansion rule.", "Population, sample, selection, failure, and expansion test."]

["METH-005", "Criticality, severity, priority, confidence, residual risk, and conclusion rules operate consistently across supported packs and disclose approved differences.", "Cross-pack consistency and exception review."]

["METH-006", "Customer factual challenge, independent quality review, correction, reissuance, withdrawal, expiration, and reassessment preserve history and authority separation.", "End-to-end governance exercise."]

["METH-007", "Assessment outputs state intended use, limitations, validity, evidence cutoff, uncertainty, and prohibited claims clearly enough for the target audience.", "Report usability, legal-claims, and assurance review."]
["METH-008", "The methodology can be executed manually from controlled templates and through UACRF Assess without changing substantive results.", "Manual-to-product equivalence test."]

source_json_specification_verbatim: The platform shall register each protected agent workload with a tenant, environment, service identity, accountable owner, runtime principal, intended purpose and workload kind.

The platform shall bind each execution to an immutable workload version containing model, instruction, knowledge, tool, memory, data and evaluation contracts, and shall require a new version for a material change.

The platform shall retain qualified and version-bound agent dependencies, including tool effects, identity, model, knowledge, memory, runtime and handoff dependencies, without treating topology alone as proof of eligibility or recovery independence.
The platform shall enforce authenticated scoped admission, a deadline and atomic per-attempt limits for steps, tokens and cost before runtime dispatch, including each parallel child.

The platform shall retain an attributed append-only event stream and shall return the original receipt for an identical source key and content while rejecting a conflicting reuse without a second budget debit.

The platform shall isolate sensitive memory and checkpoint artifacts by authorized scope and shall bind an eligible checkpoint to verified bytes, the workload version, input digest, event sequence, namespace and expiry.

The platform shall fence cancellation and pause requests at admission and dispatch, preserve late output without accepting it as eligible, and reconcile uncertain external effects before retry or resumption.

The platform shall require the existing governed recovery authority chain for consequential agent recovery and shall bind the recovery workflow to the exact source execution, checkpoint, evaluation and target version without granting recovery authority to the agent.

The platform shall stage resumption as a new linked execution with no greater remaining budget or deadline and shall reject stale evaluation, expired checkpoint, unresolved effects or incompatible context.

The platform shall assess agent recovery against a versioned mandatory evaluation suite and qualified observations of task, data, security and business outcomes, preserving FAIL or UNKNOWN when required checks are absent.
The platform shall preserve agent execution, context, tool effect, handoff, evaluation and recovery lineage in its decision evidence and shall retain a governed human continuation route.

The platform shall distinguish runtime reservations, measured provider usage and customer charges, correlate child attempts, prevent duplicate receipt charges and preserve safety controls when billing is unavailable.
